name: eop-request
description: Pure C++ Earth orientation request builder for three switchable sources (typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only, no JSON and no base64). Each method turns ONE TimerTick (TICK) into ONE HttpRequest (HREQ) for hostcap/http-request: GET the method's file, TIMEOUT_MS 90000, MAX_BYTES 16777216 (the host errors past it, never truncates), CONTEXT the parser job as one size-prefixed SDS $ICN record (CONNECTOR_ID and DATASET_ID the format finals2000a / c04 / paris, SOURCE_NAME the series name, ENDPOINT_URL the file, KIND HttpsPull, TARGET_SCHEMA EOP.fbs, EMITS_SCHEMAS [EOP]) that the connector echoes in the HttpResponse for eop-parser. A second tick in one invocation is refused. No config, no hostcalls, no capabilities.
